Kanchan Natekar successfully made this transition by moving from a five-year career in dentistry to the fast-growing field of data analytics. With a passion for learning new technologies and building analytical skills, she transformed her professional journey. Today, she is working as a Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst at Suma Soft Pvt Ltd , proving that career changes are possible with determination and the right guidance. Background Kanchan spent five years working as a dentist, where she developed strong problem-solving, observation, and decision-making skills. However, she wanted a career that offered greater exposure to technology, data, and business intelligence. While exploring new opportunities, she discovered the growing demand for data analytics professionals across industries. Choosing a Data Analytics course in Pune became the first step toward building a future in the IT sector. Upskilling with 3RI Technologies At 3RI Technologies, Kanchan received industry-focused training that helped her build a strong foundation in data analytics. She learned Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, and data visualization through practical assignments and live projects. The program also included real-world case studies, certification guidance, and interview preparation sessions. This hands-on learning experience enabled her to develop the confidence and technical expertise required to begin a successful career in analytics. Transition to Company After completing her training and consistently improving her practical skills, Kanchan secured an opportunity with Suma Soft Pvt Ltd . Her Microsoft Power BI certification, combined with project experience and technical knowledge, helped her stand out during the recruitment process. The placement support and interview mentoring from 3RI Technologies played an important role in making her transition from healthcare to IT smooth and successful. Achievements as a Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst As a Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst at Suma Soft Pvt Ltd , Kanchan works with business data to create meaningful dashboards and interactive reports that support informed decision-making. She transforms raw data into actionable insights using modern analytics tools and visualization techniques. Her journey reflects how continuous learning and dedication can help professionals build rewarding careers in technology after completing a Data Analytics course in Pune . Conclusion Kanchan Natekar’s inspiring journey demonstrates that a professional background does not define future career opportunities. By embracing new skills, earning industry-recognized certifications, and gaining practical experience through 3RI Technologies, she successfully transitioned from dentistry to data analytics. Her achievement as a Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst at Suma Soft Pvt Ltd encourages aspiring professionals from non-IT backgrounds to confidently pursue careers in the rapidly growing world of data and analytics.
